messages:
Asha Patel: Heads up — I spotted ~12% of recently imported accounts with owner = 'unassigned'. Playbooks that route onboarding nudges by owner are misfiring. Can we do a quick admin cleanup + a sampler dry-run before the rollout next Tue? :eyes:

Miguel Santos: Ugh, thanks for catching. I can run a sampling job to show the affected cohorts. Want me to include the signup date window and account tier?

Asha Patel: Yes please — last 30 days and tiers: free, startup, pro. We need numbers per owner-state and a small csv sample (100 rows) for Priya to review.

Miguel Santos: Will do. Quick query I'm planning:```sql
SELECT account_id, owner_id, owner_status, tier, created_at
FROM accounts
WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
  AND owner_status = 'unassigned'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 500;
```
I'll export the first 100 to csv and drop in #cs-ops-artifacts.

Priya Reddy: Thanks. Important: do NOT write updates to owner fields until we validate identity resolution. We should treat this as a normalization step — propose adding a `owner_candidate` field in the admin UI first, then promote to `owner_id` after manual review or a safe auto-rule.

Tom Nguyen: I can run the admin UI dry-run and the promotion script in a sandbox. Plan: import Miguel's csv into the sandbox, run `promote_owner_candidates --dry-run` and capture diffs. If diff rate < 3% and no conflicting ownership alerts, we schedule a controlled write to staging then prod.

Asha Patel: Sounds good. Also want to add a temporary health-scorer gating rule so accounts with owner = 'unassigned' don't drop into auto-renewal nudges. We don't want spam to wrong owners.

Miguel Santos: I'll add a computed flag `owner_resolved = false` for those rows and push a tagging metric to the health dashboard (datadog tag: cs.owner_unassigned).

OnboardBot: :robot_face: playbook-scheduler created sampler-run #615 for thread 1717004321. Runs at 2024-05-03T18:10:00Z. Output will be posted to #cs-ops-artifacts.

Priya Reddy: When Miguel posts the csv, I'll run a quick identity resolution pass (email/domain heuristics + workspace membership). If we get >80% high-confidence matches, we can author an auto-rule to set owner_candidate for those.

Tom Nguyen: Timeline check — Miguel to post csv today, Priya to review by EOD, Tom to run sandbox dry-run tomorrow morning, Asha to approve staging write by tomorrow afternoon. If anything blocks, escalate to @Miguel and @Tom.

Asha Patel: I'll draft rollback steps in the incident playbook: include `revert_owner_promotion --snapshot <ts>` and contact list. Also adding a temporary alert: if promote script changes >5% of accounts in prod, abort.

Miguel Santos: CSV uploaded to #cs-ops-artifacts (owners-sample-1717004321.csv). Running an initial count now.

Miguel Santos: Counts: total_unassigned_30d=4,812; free=3,100; startup=1,200; pro=512. Sample 100 csv attached. :chart_with_upwards_trend: 

Priya Reddy: Reviewing sample — seeing a handful of accounts where owner may be external consultant, flagging 6/100 as conflict. Otherwise looks matchable by email domain. I'll post notes in the csv and add a `conflict_reason` column.

Tom Nguyen: Kicked off `promote_owner_candidates --dry-run --input owners-sample-1717004321.csv` in sandbox. No writes. Diff summary: 100 rows -> 92 candidates assigned, 6 conflicts, 2 ambiguous. Diff rate 92%.

Asha Patel: Great. Given that, approve a staged run for 1,000 accounts in staging tomorrow at 09:00 PT. Tom/Miguel, coordinate the staging job and share the exact command and snapshot id. Priya, please prepare the conflict quarantine process.

Miguel Santos: Command for staging run (example):```bash
./promote_owner_candidates --input owners-staging-batch-1000.csv --mode staged --snapshot s_20240503_0915
```
I'll also add a `--safety-threshold 0.05` that will abort if >5% conflicts.

Priya Reddy: I'll set up the quarantine label `owner_conflict_review` and create a short checklist: confirm email match, check workspace membership, ask CSM if unsure.

OnboardBot: :white_check_mark: scheduled staged promotion job #616 for 2024-05-04T16:00:00Z (sandbox). Logs will auto-post to #cs-ops-artifacts.

Tom Nguyen: After staging completes, I'll run a smoke test for playbook triggers and healthscore changes. If smoke is clear, we can plan the prod run the following day with a 1% ramp every 30 minutes.

Asha Patel: Thanks everyone. I'll add this plan to the weekly CS operations doc and ping legal if any PII concerns come up during the identity resolution steps.

Miguel Santos: Noted. I'll also add a short entry to the rollout checklist about toggling the healthscore gate back on after promotion.

Priya Reddy: All set on my side for today. I'll update the csv with conflict notes in ~2 hours.

Tom Nguyen: I'll stay on standby for the sandbox run. Ping me in thread when csv is updated. :thumbsup:

Asha Patel: Closing loop — we have a plan + owners. Thanks team.
